heard: President Bill Clinton went on television to announce a rock from Mars. In December 1984, meteorite hunters exploring the Allen Hills region of Antarctica discovered an unusual four-pound specimen. A colossal asteroid impact had blasted this ancient stone off the Martian surface around 16 million years ago. After drifting through the freezing vacuum of the solar system, The meteorite finally landed on Earth approximately 13,000 years ago. In 1996, NASA scientists announced the specimen contained microscopic structures measuring 20 to 100 nanometers in diameter. Though most researchers eventually rejected a biological origin, this remarkable Martian rock inspired that historic television address by the President.
